sources_described: San Jose Water Company (SJWC) - Mountain Surface Water; Montevina Water Treatment Plant (purchased water). Drinking Water Watch lists the SJWC connection as the only active source; Fern Gulch spring and Well 01 are abandoned.

extraction_notes: Report is a Word (.docx) file served by the State Water Board EAR portal (format 'docx'); it has no fixed pagination, so page is null for every entry. The title says '2023 Consumer Confidence Report' and Drinking Water Watch files it under 2023, but the report itself states it covers monitoring for January 1 to December 31, 2022, so data_year is 2022; most rows print the sample date only as '2023' (lead/copper 9/18/2022), which is recorded as sample_year as printed. Much of the state small-system template is unfilled ('[Enter Water System's Name]' placeholders). Copper 90th percentile cell reads '90%'. HAA5 PHG cell is the placeholder '[Enter No.]'. Table 6 (unregulated contaminants) and the violation tables 7, 9 and 11 are all 'NONE'. The 2025 slot on Drinking Water Watch holds a different system's report (Resthaven Mobile Home Park), so this 2022-data report is the newest genuine Oakmont CCR available.
